findings.highlight: enemies will not attack you as long as you stay on your home ground
findings.evidenceJa: ホームグランドにいる限り、敵は簡単には襲いかかってこない
findings.governingReading: On a magus’s home ground, enemies cannot attack easily or casually.
findings.explanation: Will not attack turns a tactical deterrent into categorical safety, which Shirou’s mere alarm boundary does not justify.

findings.highlight: if you reveal your potential, you’ll surely be beaten someday
findings.evidenceJa: 戦力を明かしてちゃ、いつか寝首をかかれる
findings.governingReading: If one reveals combat capabilities, an enemy will eventually catch them asleep or otherwise assassinate them unawares.
findings.explanation: Potential broadens concrete fighting strength, while beaten removes the lethal surprise-betrayal image in 寝首をかく.

findings.highlight: I can take care of myself.
findings.evidenceJa: それぐらいの駆け引きはできるぞ、俺
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists he can manage at least that degree of strategic maneuvering or deception.
findings.explanation: Take care of myself changes social strategy into general self-sufficiency or defense.

findings.highlight: don’t worry about it
findings.evidenceJa: 駆け引きなんて考えるのは止めなさい
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to stop contemplating mind games because he has other virtues.
findings.explanation: Don’t worry about it removes her judgment about his unsuitability for strategic deception.

findings.highlight: He’d happily sell my information to the other Masters.
findings.evidenceJa: 人の情報を他のマスターに売るぐらいはやりかねないわ
findings.governingReading: Rin says Kirei is capable even of selling someone’s information to another Master.
findings.explanation: Would happily promotes a feared possibility into habitual willingness and adds enjoyment.

findings.highlight: her words do seem to hold a bit of affection
findings.evidenceJa: 神父への親しみが含まれている気がした
findings.governingReading: Shirou senses some familiarity or personal warmth toward Kirei in Rin’s words despite her distrust.
findings.explanation: Affection strengthens 親しみ toward love or fondness and overstates the relationship.

findings.highlight: our cold breath
findings.evidenceJa: 吐きだされる白い吐息
findings.governingReading: Their exhaled breath is visibly white in the winter air.
findings.explanation: Cold breath replaces a concrete visual image with a temperature property.

findings.highlight: We three walk together without doing much.
findings.evidenceJa: 帰るべき場所へと歩いていく
findings.governingReading: The three walk, doing nothing in particular, toward the place to which they ought to return.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the shared direction and destination that give the temporary walk its sense of belonging and impending separation.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka falls silent for some reason.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の家は俺とは反対方向にある
findings.governingReading: The narration moves from Rin’s startled response directly to Shirou recalling where her house lies.
findings.explanation: The English inserts unexplained silence as a reaction to his statement of liking, pushing the scene toward a more explicit romantic reading.

findings.highlight: if you, her Master, gets killed
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方がやられちゃったらそれまで
findings.governingReading: If Shirou as Master is taken out, everything ends regardless of Saber’s excellence.
findings.explanation: Killed narrows defeat or incapacitation to death and repeats the rule distortion already found in Kirei’s explanation.

findings.highlight: a knife is pushed right against my naked chest
findings.evidenceJa: むき出しの腹に、ピタリと包丁を押し当てられている感覚
findings.governingReading: The killing presence feels like a knife pressed flush against Shirou’s exposed abdomen.
findings.explanation: Chest changes the precise vulnerable body location in the fear image.

findings.highlight:
Still, I feel nothing.
Probably because there’s too little hope of me getting out of this alive.
All fears and impatience are drowned by hopelessness, so I don’t feel a thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 少しでも動けばその瞬間に死んでいるだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou accepts that the slightest movement would mean immediate death and compares the sensation to a knife at his abdomen.
findings.explanation: The English adds a full explanation of emotional numbness, hopelessness, fear, and impatience absent from the bound source.

findings.highlight: He’s totally on a completely different level.
findings.evidenceJa: あいつ、桁違いだ
findings.governingReading: Rin says Berserker is on an entirely different scale.
findings.explanation: Totally and completely redundantly stack intensifiers into visibly unedited English.

findings.highlight: But it’ll come to nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: しかし、それも僅かな物だろう
findings.governingReading: Rin has enough room to ready herself, though probably only by a slight margin.
findings.explanation: Come to nothing predicts futility rather than limiting the degree of composure she retains.

findings.highlight: You should work it out if I make that ‘Illyasviel von Einzbern’.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルンって言えばわかるでしょ？
findings.governingReading: Illya says Rin should recognize her when she gives the full name Illyasviel von Einzbern.
findings.explanation: The English is grammatically incoherent and does not express name-based recognition.

findings.highlight:
I’ll kill you.
Go ahead, Berserker.
findings.evidenceJa: じゃあいくね。やっちゃえ、バーサーカー
findings.governingReading: Illya brightly announces that she is starting and orders Berserker to do it.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a direct “I’ll kill you,” changing delegated, childlike command into a personal declaration.

findings.highlight: My body is numb, but maybe that’s why my mind is so calm.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は麻痺しているクセに、頭だけは冷静に働くのか
findings.governingReading: Despite his paralyzed body, only Shirou’s head may still be working calmly.
findings.explanation: That’s why turns the concessive mismatch into a causal claim that paralysis produces calm thought.

findings.highlight: Berserker’s body explodes from Tohsaka’s spell.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の呪文と共にバーサーカーの体が弾ける
findings.governingReading: Rin’s spell strikes Berserker and his body jolts or bursts under the impact, yet remains unwounded.
findings.explanation: Explodes describes bodily destruction directly contradicted by the immediate statement that he has not even a scratch.

findings.highlight: she faces the enemy she cannot compare to
findings.evidenceJa: 敵うはずのない敵へと立ち向かった
findings.governingReading: Saber confronts an enemy she cannot possibly defeat or match.
findings.explanation: Cannot compare to is malformed for inability to prevail and usually means the two are categorically unlike.

findings.highlight: In that pool of blood
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮血が散っていく。その中で
findings.governingReading: Fresh blood scatters through the air or scene; amid it, Saber rises.
findings.explanation: Pool invents accumulated blood on the ground and changes a dynamic visual transition into a static location.

findings.highlight: She stands up unconsciously.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識のないまま立ち上がった
findings.governingReading: Saber stands despite being without consciousness.
findings.explanation: Unconsciously can mean automatically or without realizing, weakening actual loss of consciousness into involuntary behavior.

findings.highlight:
It’s as if she is saying I would be killed if she didn’t do so.
…It’s as if…
She is saying I would be killed if she didn’t do so
findings.evidenceJa: 残された俺が、殺される
findings.governingReading: Shirou reads Saber’s unconscious rising as though she were saying that otherwise he would be killed.
findings.explanation: The English prints the same inference twice with a broken restart, damaging the climax and making an interpretation look reiterated by the text.

findings.highlight:
I don’t even need to say who the ones getting killed are.
Saber will be killed right here.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒されるのが誰かは言うまでもない。彼女はここで殺される。
findings.governingReading: It is obvious who will be defeated: Saber will be killed here.
findings.explanation: The ones getting killed makes the referent plural before the next sentence identifies the singular Saber, momentarily including Shirou and Rin and breaking number agreement.
